scenario: DS-source twin of the K vector formal/k/rgate.cool_suppress: the first fire is at mock-clock instant 0, and an activation 5s later, inside the 10s window, is suppressed. Drives adapter_ds_rate_allow (rete/adapters.c) on the has_fired branch with last_fire_ns == 0: a runtime that reads a zero stamp as never fired lets this second activation through (formal/idris/Rete/RateGate.idr, rlow_4_6_2_2__zero_stamp_is_lost). The second activation is a mutable-slot change under the same key, so it reaches the gate as a fresh token with the same activation key. The rule still activates and emits rule_fire_begin for the suppressed one (LCDB.3.2.1.1, RHS-level suppression) -- this fixture reads the log messages, not the fire events, on purpose.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
    n: Int mutable

rule r cooldown 10_s:
    Trig t
->
    log info "fire {t.k}"
